codeReview.summary: The feature cleanly hardens VAL-LOAD-014 by adding a focused Playwright regression test that distinguishes normal pre-entry browser history from dashboard-created navigation state. The new coverage exercises representative in-app interactions, confirms URL/history-state stability across them, and verifies that browser back/forward traverse only the deliberately seeded pre-entry entry rather than any dashboard-created history state.
